sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Transactions_Lots"."transaction_id" AS e, "Ref_Transaction_Types"."transaction_type_description" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Transactions_Lots" JOIN "Transactions" ON "Transactions"."transaction_id" = "Transactions_Lots"."transaction_id" JOIN "Ref_Transaction_Types" ON "Ref_Transaction_Types"."transaction_type_code" = "Transactions"."transaction_type_code" GROUP BY "Transactions_Lots"."transaction_id", "Ref_Transaction_Types"."transaction_type_description"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
